one_liner: Netlify has a broad REST API with self-serve PATs and OAuth2 apps, a free plan, and an official MCP server; ready to build.
auth_notes: Users can create OAuth apps in User Settings > Applications (authorization-code style flow with redirect URL) and personal access tokens. Docs say public integrations must use OAuth2.
access_notes: The Free plan ($0, 300 credits) includes 'Deploy from AI, Git, or API'. No separate API charge; API usage consumes the same credit pool.
blocker_notes: None; free account gives credentials and OAuth app registration is self-serve.

evidence.quote: If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2
To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header:
Select “New OAuth app” and fill in any details for your project.
Deploy from AI, Git, or API
There is no separate charge for calling the Netlify REST API and no API-specific plan.
Every action available in the Netlify UI is powered by an API endpoint.
